$comment: Named, versioned machine-verification suite for cinatra-ai/cinatra — the gate-arm half of the truthful verification-record model (the Truthful Attribution protocol §4). The truthful-attribution-gate reads THIS file at the merged SHA (authoritative, no TOCTOU) when a merge record carries a Gate-suite arm: the cited suiteId@version must equal this file's, the Accountable trailer must equal accountable{github,name,email}, and every requiredContexts entry must have concluded success on the reviewed head. highRiskPaths EXTENDS the central cinatra-ai/ci defaults (the gate verifies the effective set is a superset). High-risk changes (this file is itself one — see **/gate-suite.json in the defaults) require the HUMAN arm at tier=maintainer; the gate arm alone is rejected, so this file's birth carries a maintainer Reviewed-by, not a self-blessing gate arm. lastAuditedAt + auditEvidence are the §4 monthly-audit record; the Accountable engineer re-audits monthly and bumps BOTH coupled in one commit (the gate warns >35d, fails the gate arm >65d; the human arm is always still available).
auditEvidence: 2026-07-05 merge_group activation (engineering#484, part of the merge-train-race epic engineering#482, sequenced AFTER the engineering#483 content-binding keystone which is COMPLETE and already reflected in the 45826486 pin below): added `merge_group:` triggers to the 5 required-gate callers enumerated in scripts/audit/merge-group-gate-coverage.mjs (REQUIRED_GATE_CALLERS) so each reports its required context on GitHub merge-queue candidates, not just pull_request/push. source-leak-gate and truthful-attribution-gate gained callerPath + allowedEvents (now ["pull_request","push","merge_group"]) so the engine's WF-id F1 declared-allowedEvents check (fails closed if the run event is outside the declared set) now guards both. The other three enumerated callers are NOT in requiredContexts (unchanged by this commit) — they have no Gate-suite-arm cross-check today, independent of this activation. No pin bump needed: both entries already point at ci@45826486, a descendant of both cinatra-ai/ci#59 (c3bc633, the merge_group-aware diff-base resolver shared by source-leak and the skills gate) and cinatra-ai/ci#60 (the content/diff-binding keystone), so the merge_group arm is exercised by code already live at this SHA. Content-binding is what makes a merge_group synthetic commit re-derive the SAME reviewed content hash as its source PR — without it a queue candidate would fail every gate honestly as stale/tree-mismatch (per the #483 sequencing rationale). Still INERT: no merge queue is enabled on this repo (that is engineering#485, explicitly out of scope here); these triggers simply stop being dead code once #485 lands. version bumped 2026.07.1->2026.07.2 for this callerPath/allowedEvents content change (pinned SHAs unchanged).
